chapters.title: Reading Momentum
paragraphs: The relative strength index measures how quickly prices have moved.
Traders compare the relative strength index with a simple moving average before acting.
A breakout above resistance is more convincing when volume expands.
Every breakout needs a stop loss placed below the prior swing low.

chapters.title: Managing Risk
paragraphs: Position sizing decides how much capital each trade may risk.
A trailing stop loss follows the moving average as the trend develops.
When the relative strength index diverges from price, reduce position sizing.
Failed breakouts are common in quiet markets, so keep every stop loss tight.
